summary: The join queue on a full server. The server keeps the line, tells each waiting player their place, waiting time and any status from resources, and admits the first player when a place opens. The order is first come, first served, unless resources change it through playerQueued and playerUnqueued. To admit only listed players, use whitelist.json in the resources folder.

list.summary: Those waiting, with the next player first.
list.returns: { id, nickname, steamId, ip, waitedSeconds, priority }[]
list.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("consoleCommand", function(command)
  if command ~= "queue" then
    return
  end
  for _, entry in ipairs(kcds.core.Queue.list()) do
    print(tostring(entry.nickname) .. " waits " .. tostring(entry.waitedSeconds) .. " s (priority " .. tostring(entry.priority) .. ")")
  end
end)

setPriority.summary: Sets a player's priority. Higher goes first, and ties go by arrival.
setPriority.exampleLua:
kcds.core.Events.on("playerQueued", function(entry)
  if supporters:has(entry.steamId) then
    kcds.core.Queue.setPriority(entry.id, 10)
  end
end)

setStatus.summary: Sets what the player's queue popup shows. Without it, the popup shows their place and time.

params.status: { line, fields }: a plain-text line and up to 3 { label, value } pairs.

setStatus.exampleLua: kcds.core.Queue.setStatus(entry.id, { line = "Supporters go first.", fields = { { label = "Priority", value = "Supporter" } } })
setStatus.exampleCs: Queue.SetStatus(entry["id"], new { line = "Supporters go first.", fields = new object[] { new { label = "Priority", value = "Supporter" } } });

reject.summary: Turns a player away from the queue.

params.reason: Optional: text shown to the player.

reject.example: kcds.core.Queue.reject(entry.id, 'The server is full for tonight.');
reject.exampleLua: kcds.core.Queue.reject(entry.id, "The server is full for tonight.")
reject.exampleCs: Queue.Reject(entry["id"], "The server is full for tonight.");
